purpose: Track new papers across the broader computational and coherent X-ray imaging research direction, not only PSI CXI publications.

primary_seed_group.name: Computational X-ray Imaging group, Paul Scherrer Institute

external_search_sources: synchrotron and XFEL facility publication pages
major coherent imaging and microscopy conference proceedings
include_rules: Include any paper listed on the PSI CXI publications page.
Include papers with PSI CXI authors even when published outside the PSI website.

Include papers from any institution if they advance core methods such as ptychography, phase retrieval, holography, nanotomography, SAXS tensor tomography, vector/tensor tomography, sparse/dynamic/operando X-ray imaging, or closely related reconstruction algorithms.
Include application papers when the imaging method, beamline experiment, reconstruction pipeline, or quantitative analysis is clearly connected to coherent or computational X-ray imaging.
Include ambiguous but potentially relevant candidates as needs_review instead of discarding them silently.
exclude_rules: Exclude generic X-ray characterization papers with no coherent, computational, tomographic, ptychographic, holographic, SAXS imaging, or advanced reconstruction component.
Exclude unrelated PSI or synchrotron publications unless the imaging method or analysis pipeline is central.
Exclude papers where X-ray is only a routine validation tool and not part of the scientific or technical contribution.
weekly_update_expectations: Search beyond PSI CXI every week.
Record source URLs and DOI whenever possible.
Generate Chinese explanations for every accepted new paper.
List needs_review candidates in the update log.
